Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1315
Claimant:
Jerome Lang
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
20 Aug 2024
Claim received for a left-turn collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck by an oncoming car. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
24 Sep 2024
Reviewed the police report and the statements from two independent witnesses. Both describe the other vehicle
entering the intersection during the claimant's turn, and both confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the
time.
6 Oct 2024
Photographs from the secne and the body shop show damage to the driver's side front quarter panel that lines up well
with the reported angle of impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle appears in our records or in the inspection notes.
7 Oct 2024
The coverage on the policy was in force at the time of loss, and the driver is listed as a named insured on the
declarations page. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
28 Oct 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the initial medical summary. The claimed injury is a lower back
strain, which fits the kind and force of a side impact of this type.
4 Nov 2024
The other driver's account of the collision matches the claimant's account and the witness statements in its sequence
and general details. Our file now contains consistent accounts from all parties.
25 Nov 2024
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account matched the one given at first notice
and again in the follow-up call, with no meaningful changes in sequence or detail.
3 Dec 2024
Medical records show a course of treatment that followed a typical pattern, with pain and mobility improving steadily
over several weeks. Treatment tapered as the claimant's condition improved, which is consistent with the diagnosis.
16 Jan 2025
The claimant's prior records include a minor strain to the same area many years ago, which the treating provider
documented as fully resolved. Nothing in the current treatment suggests a lasting or unrelated condition.
25 Jan 2025
Reviewed the full file with the vehicle damage estimate, witness statements, and medical timeline. Everything
supports the reported loss as described, and the claim is being moved to the next stage for evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
